## Summary

Applied the upstream fix (pallets/click PR #3582) to `src/click/decorators.py`:

- `version_option`'s callback now falls back to `importlib.metadata.packages_distributions()` when the resolved `package_name` doesn't match an installed distribution directly — resolving cases like top-level module `PIL` → distribution `Pillow`.
- Raises a clearer `RuntimeError` if the import name maps to multiple distributions (ambiguous, needs explicit `package_name`), and preserves the original "not installed" error when it maps to none.
- Updated docstring/versionchanged note, `CHANGES.md` entry, and added 3 tests in `tests/test_basic.py` covering the resolved case, the ambiguous case, and the unresolved case.

Full test suite passes with the same pre-existing 37 failures (unrelated environment/deprecation issues, verified identical before and after the change); all `version_option` tests pass.
